Shares printed in full (142,229,122) and divided by 1,000. Check: 374,237/142,229.122 = 2.63; 389,712/142,229.122 = 2.74. Core adjustments sum to 389,712 from FFO 374,237. Labels for JV promote, SIP reserve, advocacy, other real estate activity, condo carry cost and income tax were categorized as 'other'.
